name: Zep Cloud
ontology_notes: Closed core on Graphiti. Public types are Context Graph artifacts: facts (edges with validity), entities, episodes, thread summaries, document summaries, observations (Flex Plus/Enterprise), and user summary. User graph vs standalone graph. Threads of messages ingest into the user graph by default. Custom entity/edge types exist. Not companion lore vs experienced vs OOC.

ontology.evidence: help.getzep.com/context-types.md lists facts, entities, episodes, thread summaries, observations, user summary. graph-overview.md stores facts on edges. These are agent-memory primitives, not companion autobiography/relationship/lore tables.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: concepts.md: thread.add_messages and graph.add ingest chat and business data. Memory MCP add_memory writes when the connection allows writes. memory-security.md says the application must validate content and not give the model an unrestricted client. Zep itself extracts the graph.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: thread.get_user_context assembles a Context Block (Smart Context Assembly over the last four messages). graph.search with scope=auto composes a character-budgeted block (default max_characters 2500, cap 50000). ABAC can deny reads. The app still injects the block into the model.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: concepts.md Fact Invalidation: when new data invalidates a prior fact, the invalid time is stored on that fact's edge. graph-overview.md: edge timestamps record when a fact becomes valid or invalid. Matches Graphiti invalidate-not-delete.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Facts are time-scoped. Auto search interprets relative phrases (yesterday, last week) as retrieval windows using the user timezone. Explicit datetime filters exist for edge search. Paper and product both stress bi-temporal graphs.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: A User has one user graph and many threads. Standalone graphs hold shared/business knowledge. That splits user vs reference data, not user vs character vs relationship. Custom types can model more if the app defines them.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Governance ABAC and episode_metadata_filters restrict source and action, not socially wrong-but-relevant recall (kink, trauma, spoilers). search.md has no silence API.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: memory-security.md is explicit about memory poisoning. Rule: memory is evidence, not an instruction. Place Context Blocks in untrusted data channels. Episode metadata projects onto derived facts for source filters. ABAC on API keys. Write-time jailbreak classifiers are not documented as a Zep feature; the app owns that boundary.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: memory-security.md: delete episode, thread, user, node, or edge APIs. Metadata exclusion can hide content without deletion. MCP connection can be switched read-only. User-facing forget-that still depends on the app calling those APIs.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Product claims sub-200ms retrieval and token-efficient Context Blocks. Auto search packs to max_characters (default 2500). Extraction LLM cost is server-side and unpublished per episode. Paper LongMemEval used about 1.6k context tokens vs 115k full context.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Closed core. README contrast: Zep is managed or in-your-cloud on a proprietary Context Graph Engine. Graphiti is the self-hosted OSS engine. Intimate chat cannot stay on one machine with only Zep Cloud.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official Memory MCP at https://api.getzep.com/mcp (memory-mcp-server.md) plus docs MCP at help.getzep.com/_mcp/server. Memory MCP tools include search_graph, add_memory, get_user_summary.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Best-in-slice temporal invalidation, user graphs, and written poisoning guidance. Still enterprise agent memory. Closed internals. Context Block into the prompt is retrieve-equals-remember. No companion ontology or silence. Local intimate chat is Graphiti, not Zep Cloud.

published_eval.name: DMR (MSC subset), LongMemEval-s, plus Graphiti LoCoMo/LongMemEval claims
published_eval.claimed_score: Paper: DMR 94.8% gpt-4-turbo / 98.2% gpt-4o-mini (top-10 nodes+edges). LongMemEval-s 63.8% gpt-4o-mini and 71.2% gpt-4o vs 55.4%/60.2% full-context, ~1.6k vs 115k tokens. Product Graphiti overview also cites LoCoMo 94.7% / LongMemEval 90.2%.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Multi-session chat fact QA (DMR/MSC) and LongMemEval assistant memory questions (preference, temporal, knowledge-update, multi-session). Not companion identity drift or socially wrong recall.

open_unknowns: Closed Context Graph Engine internals (extraction prompts, invalidation heuristics, observation deriver).
Whether BYOC can run without sending chat text off the operator's machines beyond the chosen LLM.
How Zep maps a companion character if two characters share one user_id.
